description: Read the website score for the business the account selects, from its latest linked website report: website_url, checked_at, score (0 to 100, or null), score_line (for example "82 of 100, 10 points from your overrides"), override_points, site_type (the kind of business the score was weighed for, from the owner or the listing), groups (search, AI assistants, consistency, booking, AI agents, each with points_earned and points_possible), overrides (check_id, label and the owner's own reason; null while overrides are off), failed_checks (check_id, group, label, weight and the problem in plain words), can_override and can_run_check. Or state no_report, or error with a message. Requires company:read; the account selects the business. Read-only.
name: get_visibility_report
title: Get my website score
